relations.text_en: Makes farm, ATV and truck tires under the Goodyear brand under license

source.label: Titan International 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company has royalty-bearing trademark license agreements with Goodyear to manufacture and sell certain farm, ATV and truck tires under the Goodyear brand.

relations.text: 買収したクーパー・タイヤのブランド無形資産で減損を計上
relations.text_en: Acquired Cooper Tire; took an impairment on its lower-tier brand intangibles

source.label: Goodyear 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: primarily related to our lower tier indefinite-lived intangible assets related to the acquisition of Cooper Tire as a result of increased competition from lower tier imports in the market.

relations.text: 世界での2大競合の一社
relations.text_en: One of its two major worldwide competitors

source.label: Goodyear 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On a worldwide basis, we have two major competitors: Bridgestone (based in Japan) and Michelin (based in France). Other significant competitors include Continental, Hankook, Kumho, Pirelli, Sumitomo, Toyo, Yokohama and various regional tire manufacturers.
